confidence_notes: Food anchors use Sihanoukville aggregated prices last updated January 2026, cross-checked against Cambodia-wide October 2026 data; the city sample is limited. Cocktail and wine estimates are rough multiples of the $1 draft beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Sihanoukville-specific meal, beer, and cappuccino indicators, with Cambodia-wide prices as a broad cross-check. Accommodation estimates reflect general knowledge of Cambodian coastal guesthouses and hotels.
